theorems.name: RegionTable.released_state
theorems.claim: A released record is in the Retired state.
theorems.statement: RegionTable.released_state : ∀ (record : noble_kernel.resources.Snapshot), (RegionTable.released record).state = noble_kernel.resources.State.Retired

theorems.name: RegionTable.opened_handle
theorems.claim: Opening a borrow keeps the record's handle.
theorems.statement: RegionTable.opened_handle : ∀ (record : noble_kernel.resources.Snapshot) (serial : Aeneas.Std.U64), (RegionTable.opened record serial).handle = record.handle

theorems.name: RegionTable.returned_handle
theorems.claim: Returning the owner keeps the record's handle.
theorems.statement: RegionTable.returned_handle : ∀ (record : noble_kernel.resources.Snapshot) (serial : Aeneas.Std.U64), (RegionTable.returned record serial).handle = record.handle

theorems.name: RegionTable.released_handle
theorems.claim: Releasing keeps the record's handle.
theorems.statement: RegionTable.released_handle : ∀ (record : noble_kernel.resources.Snapshot), (RegionTable.released record).handle = record.handle

theorems.name: RegionTable.opened_valid
theorems.claim: A well-formed live record opened under a nonzero serial is well formed.
theorems.statement: RegionTable.opened_valid : ∀ (record : noble_kernel.resources.Snapshot) (serial : Aeneas.Std.U64), M5Resources.valid record = true → record.state = noble_kernel.resources.State.Live → serial ≠ 0#u64 → M5Resources.valid (RegionTable.opened record serial) = true

theorems.name: RegionTable.access_opened
theorems.claim: Access with the open borrow's serial authorizes it and leaves the opened record unchanged.
theorems.statement: RegionTable.access_opened : ∀ (record : noble_kernel.resources.Snapshot) (serial : Aeneas.Std.U64), M5Resources.valid record = true → record.state = noble_kernel.resources.State.Live → serial ≠ 0#u64 → M5Resources.step (RegionTable.opened record serial) record.handle (noble_kernel.resources.Event.Access serial) = Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok { record := RegionTable.opened record serial, action := noble_kernel.resources.Action.Unchanged }

theorems.name: RegionTable.complete_opened
theorems.claim: Complete with the open borrow's serial returns the owner for either outcome and leaves the live record with that serial as its last scope.
theorems.statement: RegionTable.complete_opened : ∀ (record : noble_kernel.resources.Snapshot) (serial : Aeneas.Std.U64) (outcome : noble_kernel.resources.Completion), M5Resources.valid record = true → record.state = noble_kernel.resources.State.Live → serial ≠ 0#u64 → M5Resources.step (RegionTable.opened record serial) record.handle (noble_kernel.resources.Event.Complete serial outcome) = Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok { record := RegionTable.returned record serial, action := noble_kernel.resources.Action.OwnerReturned outcome }

theorems.name: RegionTable.returned_valid
theorems.claim: The record a returned borrow leaves is well formed.
theorems.statement: RegionTable.returned_valid : ∀ (record : noble_kernel.resources.Snapshot) (serial : Aeneas.Std.U64), M5Resources.valid record = true → record.state = noble_kernel.resources.State.Live → serial ≠ 0#u64 → M5Resources.valid (RegionTable.returned record serial) = true

theorems.name: RegionTable.release_live
theorems.claim: Release with the registration requirement retires a well-formed live record as a local release.
theorems.statement: RegionTable.release_live : ∀ (record : noble_kernel.resources.Snapshot), M5Resources.valid record = true → record.state = noble_kernel.resources.State.Live → M5Resources.step record record.handle (noble_kernel.resources.Event.Release (RegionTable.requirementFor record.handle)) = Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok { record := RegionTable.released record, action := noble_kernel.resources.Action.LocalRelease }

theorems.name: RegionTable.release_retired
theorems.claim: Release of a retired record is refused with Retired.
theorems.statement: RegionTable.release_retired : ∀ (record : noble_kernel.resources.Snapshot), M5Resources.valid record = true → record.state = noble_kernel.resources.State.Retired → M5Resources.step record record.handle (noble_kernel.resources.Event.Release (RegionTable.requirementFor record.handle)) = Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Err noble_kernel.resources.Error.Retired

theorems.name: RegionTable.begin_retired
theorems.claim: Begin on a retired record is refused with Retired for every serial.
theorems.statement: RegionTable.begin_retired : ∀ (record : noble_kernel.resources.Snapshot) (serial : Aeneas.Std.U64), M5Resources.valid record = true → record.state = noble_kernel.resources.State.Retired → M5Resources.step record record.handle (noble_kernel.resources.Event.Begin (RegionTable.requirementFor record.handle) serial) = Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Err noble_kernel.resources.Error.Retired

theorems.name: RegionTable.released_valid
theorems.claim: Releasing a well-formed record leaves a well-formed record.
theorems.statement: RegionTable.released_valid : ∀ (record : noble_kernel.resources.Snapshot), M5Resources.valid record = true → M5Resources.valid (RegionTable.released record) = true

theorems.name: RegionTable.begin_fresh
theorems.claim: Begin with the registration requirement and a fresh serial admits a borrow on a well-formed live record and opens it under that serial.
theorems.statement: RegionTable.begin_fresh : ∀ (record : noble_kernel.resources.Snapshot) (serial : Aeneas.Std.U64), M5Resources.valid record = true → record.state = noble_kernel.resources.State.Live → RegionTable.Fresh record serial → M5Resources.step record record.handle (noble_kernel.resources.Event.Begin (RegionTable.requirementFor record.handle) serial) = Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok { record := RegionTable.opened record serial, action := noble_kernel.resources.Action.BorrowAdmitted }

theorems.name: RegionTable.selected_of_records
theorems.claim: A table whose records are exactly one record at slot 0 selects that record for its handle.
theorems.statement: RegionTable.selected_of_records : ∀ (table : noble_kernel.resources.table.Table) (record : noble_kernel.resources.Snapshot), ↑table.records = [record] → ↑record.handle.slot = 0 → (↑table.records)[↑record.handle.slot]? = some record

theorems.name: RegionTable.commit_admitted
theorems.claim: With pin room, commit of an admitted borrow on the one-slot table stores the decided record, acquires one pin and keeps the scope counter and limits.
theorems.statement: RegionTable.commit_admitted : ∀ (table : noble_kernel.resources.table.Table) (decision : noble_kernel.resources.Decision) (record : noble_kernel.resources.Snapshot), ↑table.records = [record] → ↑decision.record.handle.slot = 0 → decision.action = noble_kernel.resources.Action.BorrowAdmitted → ↑table.pins < ↑table.limits.pins → ∃ committed, table.commit decision = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok (), committed) ∧ ↑committed.records = [decision.record] ∧ ↑committed.pins = ↑table.pins + 1 ∧ committed.scope = table.scope ∧ committed.limits = table.limits

theorems.name: RegionTable.commit_returned
theorems.claim: With a pin outstanding, commit of a returned owner on the one-slot table stores the decided record, releases one pin and keeps the scope counter and limits.
theorems.statement: RegionTable.commit_returned : ∀ (table : noble_kernel.resources.table.Table) (decision : noble_kernel.resources.Decision) (record : noble_kernel.resources.Snapshot) (outcome : noble_kernel.resources.Completion), ↑table.records = [record] → ↑decision.record.handle.slot = 0 → decision.action = noble_kernel.resources.Action.OwnerReturned outcome → 0 < ↑table.pins → ∃ committed, table.commit decision = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok (), committed) ∧ ↑committed.records = [decision.record] ∧ ↑committed.pins = ↑table.pins - 1 ∧ committed.scope = table.scope ∧ committed.limits = table.limits

theorems.name: RegionTable.commit_released
theorems.claim: Commit of a local release on the one-slot table stores the decided record and keeps the pins, the scope counter and the limits.
theorems.statement: RegionTable.commit_released : ∀ (table : noble_kernel.resources.table.Table) (decision : noble_kernel.resources.Decision) (record : noble_kernel.resources.Snapshot), ↑table.records = [record] → ↑decision.record.handle.slot = 0 → decision.action = noble_kernel.resources.Action.LocalRelease → ∃ committed, table.commit decision = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok (), committed) ∧ ↑committed.records = [decision.record] ∧ committed.pins = table.pins ∧ committed.scope = table.scope ∧ committed.limits = table.limits

theorems.name: RegionTable.registration_represents
theorems.claim: Table::new with the adapter's limits and the model's scope limit as the scope ceiling, then register, yields the owner and a table that represents the model's initial state, and the adapter's requirement is requirementFor of the owner's handle.
theorems.statement: RegionTable.registration_represents : ∀ (id : noble_kernel.resources.TableId) (required : noble_kernel.resources.Requirement), ∃ table, noble_kernel.resources.table.Table.new id { slots := 1#usize, pins := 1#usize, owners_per_context := 1#usize, generations := 1#u64, scopes := 64#u64 } = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok table) ∧ ∃ owner registered record, table.register required = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok owner, registered) ∧ RegionTable.Represents owner.handle NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.initial registered record ∧ RegionTable.requirementFor owner.handle = required

theorems.name: RegionTable.begin_exhausted
theorems.claim: At the scope ceiling, begin refuses with ScopeExhausted and returns the table unchanged.
theorems.statement: RegionTable.begin_exhausted : ∀ (handle : noble_kernel.resources.Handle) (s : NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.State) (table : noble_kernel.resources.table.Table) (record : noble_kernel.resources.Snapshot), RegionTable.Represents handle s table record → NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.scopeLimit ≤ s.granted → noble_kernel.resources.table.access.Table.begin table { handle := handle } (RegionTable.requirementFor handle) = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Err { error := noble_kernel.resources.Error.ScopeExhausted, input := { handle := handle } }, table)

theorems.name: RegionTable.begin_admits
theorems.claim: Below the scope ceiling, begin on a represented live owner allocates the serial granted + 1, admits the borrow, stores the opened record and holds one pin.
theorems.statement: RegionTable.begin_admits : ∀ (handle : noble_kernel.resources.Handle) (granted : ℕ) (table : noble_kernel.resources.table.Table) (record : noble_kernel.resources.Snapshot), RegionTable.Represents handle { owner := NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.Owner.live, granted := granted } table record → granted < NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.scopeLimit → ∃ serial opening, noble_kernel.resources.table.access.Table.begin table { handle := handle } (RegionTable.requirementFor handle) = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok { borrow := { scope := { handle := handle, serial := serial } }, decision := { record := RegionTable.opened record serial, action := noble_kernel.resources.Action.BorrowAdmitted } }, opening) ∧ ↑serial = granted + 1 ∧ ↑opening.records = [RegionTable.opened record serial] ∧ opening.scope = serial ∧ ↑opening.pins = 1 ∧ opening.limits = table.limits

theorems.name: RegionTable.open_borrow_returns
theorems.claim: A4 for the table: on the table holding the opened record, native_access authorizes the borrow and complete returns the owner for either outcome, stores the returned record and releases the pin.
theorems.statement: RegionTable.open_borrow_returns : ∀ (handle : noble_kernel.resources.Handle) (opening : noble_kernel.resources.table.Table) (record : noble_kernel.resources.Snapshot) (serial : Aeneas.Std.U64) (outcome : noble_kernel.resources.Completion), M5Resources.valid record = true → record.state = noble_kernel.resources.State.Live → record.handle = handle → ↑handle.slot = 0 → serial ≠ 0#u64 → ↑opening.records = [RegionTable.opened record serial] → ↑opening.pins = 1 → noble_kernel.resources.table.access.Table.native_access opening { scope := { handle := handle, serial := serial } } = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok (RegionTable.opened record serial)) ∧ ∃ closing, noble_kernel.resources.table.access.Table.complete opening { handle := handle, serial := serial } outcome = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok { owner := some { handle := handle }, decision := { record := RegionTable.returned record serial, action := noble_kernel.resources.Action.OwnerReturned outcome } }, closing) ∧ ↑closing.records = [RegionTable.returned record serial] ∧ ↑closing.pins = 0 ∧ closing.scope = opening.scope ∧ closing.limits = opening.limits

theorems.name: RegionTable.release_table
theorems.claim: release retires a represented live owner as a local release and stores the retired record, and is refused with Retired on a retired record, returning the table unchanged.
theorems.statement: RegionTable.release_table : ∀ (handle : noble_kernel.resources.Handle) (s : NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.State) (table : noble_kernel.resources.table.Table) (record : noble_kernel.resources.Snapshot), RegionTable.Represents handle s table record → (record.state = noble_kernel.resources.State.Live → ∃ retired, noble_kernel.resources.table.access.Table.release table { handle := handle } (RegionTable.requirementFor handle) = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok { record := RegionTable.released record, action := noble_kernel.resources.Action.LocalRelease }, retired) ∧ ↑retired.records = [RegionTable.released record] ∧ retired.pins = table.pins ∧ retired.scope = table.scope ∧ retired.limits = table.limits) ∧ (record.state = noble_kernel.resources.State.Retired → noble_kernel.resources.table.access.Table.release table { handle := handle } (RegionTable.requirementFor handle) = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Err { error := noble_kernel.resources.Error.Retired, input := { handle := handle } }, table))

theorems.name: RegionTable.begin_retired_table
theorems.claim: begin on a represented retired record is refused and returns the table unchanged.
theorems.statement: RegionTable.begin_retired_table : ∀ (handle : noble_kernel.resources.Handle) (s : NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.State) (table : noble_kernel.resources.table.Table) (record : noble_kernel.resources.Snapshot), RegionTable.Represents handle s table record → record.state = noble_kernel.resources.State.Retired → ∃ error, noble_kernel.resources.table.access.Table.begin table { handle := handle } (RegionTable.requirementFor handle) = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Err { error := error, input := { handle := handle } }, table)

theorems.name: RegionTable.accounting_local_releases
theorems.claim: actionReleases is the local_releases field of the extracted Decision.accounting for every decision.
theorems.statement: RegionTable.accounting_local_releases : ∀ (decision : noble_kernel.resources.Decision), ∃ accounting, decision.accounting = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok accounting ∧ ↑accounting.local_releases = RegionTable.actionReleases decision.action

theorems.name: RegionTable.read_step
theorems.claim: Under the table's host, a read on a live owner keeps it live, grants a borrow exactly when the claim is the owner's, the range is in bounds and the scope limit is not reached, and commits no release.
theorems.statement: RegionTable.read_step : ∀ (host : NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.Host) (granted claim : ℕ) (off len : ℤ), (NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.step (RegionTable.tableHost host) { owner := NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.Owner.live, granted := granted } (NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.Request.read claim off len)).next = { owner := NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.Owner.live, granted := if claim = host.owner ∧ NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.inBounds host.region.length off len = true ∧ granted < NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.scopeLimit then granted + 1 else granted } ∧ List.countP NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.isRelease (NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.step (RegionTable.tableHost host) { owner := NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.Owner.live, granted := granted } (NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.Request.read claim off len)).events = 0

theorems.name: RegionTable.calls_refine
theorems.claim: For every guest request, the adapter's table calls take a table that represents the model state to one that represents the model's next state under the table's host, accounting exactly the model's release commits.
theorems.statement: RegionTable.calls_refine : ∀ (host : NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.Host) (handle : noble_kernel.resources.Handle) (s : NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.State) (table : noble_kernel.resources.table.Table) (record : noble_kernel.resources.Snapshot) (request : NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.Request), RegionTable.Represents handle s table record → ∃ table' record', RegionTable.tableCalls host handle table request = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (table', List.countP NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.isRelease (NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.step (RegionTable.tableHost host) s request).events) ∧ RegionTable.Represents handle (NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.step (RegionTable.tableHost host) s request).next table' record'

theorems.name: RegionTable.cleanup_refines
theorems.claim: The host's cleanup through release takes a represented table to one that represents the model's retired state, accounting exactly the model's retirement commits.
theorems.statement: RegionTable.cleanup_refines : ∀ (handle : noble_kernel.resources.Handle) (s : NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.State) (table : noble_kernel.resources.table.Table) (record : noble_kernel.resources.Snapshot), RegionTable.Represents handle s table record → ∃ table' record', RegionTable.releaseCall table handle = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (table', List.countP NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.isRelease (NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.retire s).1) ∧ RegionTable.Represents handle (NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.retire s).2 table' record'

theorems.name: RegionTable.exec_refines
theorems.claim: For every program, the adapter's table calls for the model's execution keep the table representing the reached model state and account exactly the model's release commits.
theorems.statement: RegionTable.exec_refines : ∀ (host : NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.Host) (handle : noble_kernel.resources.Handle) (program : List NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.Action) (s : NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.State) (table : noble_kernel.resources.table.Table) (record : noble_kernel.resources.Snapshot), RegionTable.Represents handle s table record → ∃ table' record', RegionTable.tableExec host handle s table program = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (table', List.countP NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.isRelease (NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.exec (RegionTable.tableHost host) s program).events) ∧ RegionTable.Represents handle (NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.exec (RegionTable.tableHost host) s program).state table' record'

theorems.name: RegionTable.run_refines
theorems.claim: For every program, the adapter's table calls for a whole run with the host's cleanup leave a table that represents the model's final state and account exactly the model's release commits.
theorems.statement: RegionTable.run_refines : ∀ (host : NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.Host) (handle : noble_kernel.resources.Handle) (s : NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.State) (table : noble_kernel.resources.table.Table) (record : noble_kernel.resources.Snapshot) (program : List NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.Action), RegionTable.Represents handle s table record → ∃ table' record', RegionTable.tableRun host handle s table program = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (table', List.countP NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.isRelease (NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.run (RegionTable.tableHost host) s program).events) ∧ RegionTable.Represents handle (NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.run (RegionTable.tableHost host) s program).final table' record'

theorems.name: RegionTable.table_retires_exactly_once
theorems.claim: P1 and the cleanup claim for the table: from a represented live owner, every run's table calls end with the record retired, no pin outstanding and exactly one local release accounted.
theorems.statement: RegionTable.table_retires_exactly_once : ∀ (host : NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.Host) (handle : noble_kernel.resources.Handle) (granted : ℕ) (table : noble_kernel.resources.table.Table) (record : noble_kernel.resources.Snapshot) (program : List NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.Action), RegionTable.Represents handle { owner := NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.Owner.live, granted := granted } table record → ∃ final retiredRecord, RegionTable.tableRun host handle { owner := NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.Owner.live, granted := granted } table program = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (final, 1) ∧ ↑final.records = [retiredRecord] ∧ retiredRecord.state = noble_kernel.resources.State.Retired ∧ ↑final.pins = 0

theorems.name: M5Resources.transition_refines
theorems.statement: M5Resources.transition_refines : ∀ (record : noble_kernel.resources.Snapshot) (claim : noble_kernel.resources.Handle) (event : noble_kernel.resources.Event), noble_kernel.resources.transition.transition record claim event = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (M5Resources.step record claim event)

theorems.name: M5Resources.table_decide_refines
theorems.statement: M5Resources.table_decide_refines : ∀ (table : noble_kernel.resources.table.Table) (claim : noble_kernel.resources.Handle) (event : noble_kernel.resources.Event), table.decide claim event = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (M5Resources.tableStep table claim event)

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.exactly_one_release_commit
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.exactly_one_release_commit : ∀ (host : NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.Host) (granted : ℕ) (program : List NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.Action), List.countP NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.isRelease (NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.run host { owner := NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.Owner.live, granted := granted } program).events = if (NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.run host { owner := NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.Owner.live, granted := granted } program).final.owner = NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.Owner.lost then 0 else 1

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.run_final_owner
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.run_final_owner : ∀ (host : NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.Host) (s : NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.State) (program : List NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.Action), s.owner ≠ NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.Owner.busy → (NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.run host s program).final.owner ≠ NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.Owner.live ∧ (NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.run host s program).final.owner ≠ NobleFoundation.RegionProtocol.Owner.busy

correspondence: statements name the retained generated table functions; the Charon/Aeneas translation of the bound sources is trusted, not re-run
scope: T4: the extracted ownership::Table methods the bounded-region adapter calls (Table::new, register, begin, native_access, complete, release), sequenced as the adapter sequences them for its one-slot table, refine RegionProtocol-v1 under the host the table induces; not the Rust host functions (T5), guest lowering (T6), Wasmtime or the Canonical ABI.
assumptions: Pinned Lean and imported Aeneas/Mathlib dependency libraries are trusted; downloaded dependency .oleans are not rebuilt by this audit.
The retained Charon/Aeneas translation is trusted to model the bound Rust sources; this lane does not re-run the translation.
The retained generated M5 sources are compiled anew, not replaced with a handwritten table; all six resource source files must retain their extraction-recorded bytes.

The reviewed Aeneas library compatibility block is appended to the archived TypesExternal.lean; it restates library names the selected library dropped as the library's own definitions (VT-PIN-02 exception, #86).

The per-request table call sequence (tableCalls) is read off crates/noble-cli/src/component/bounded_region.rs; that the Rust host follows it and performs the identity and bounds checks the model states is T5 and stays open.
The model's lower oracle is the guest lowering (T6) and stays free; Wasmtime, the Canonical ABI and the CLI wrapper are not modeled.
